examples.arabic: مكنش فيه أي مشاكل والموضوع كله نهى بسرعة
examples.english: There weren't any problems and the whole matter finished quickly.
examples.transliteration: makanʃ fee ayy maʃakil wal-mawɖooʕ kullu náha b-surʕa.

examples.arabic: اخيرا نهى التسوق بتاعه واشترى التي شيرت فقط وهو راضي
examples.english: Finally, he finished his shopping and bought only the t-shirt, feeling satisfied.
examples.transliteration: ʼAkhíran náha t-tasawwoq betáʻu w-eštara t-tī-šērt faqaṭ wa húwwa ráḍi.
